Mastering Facebook Ads: Meta Ads — Beginner to Expert

Build a WhatsApp campaign with a real screenshot-led walkthrough, research public competitor ads, and install, test and troubleshoot website measurement with Meta Pixel.

AED 50
54-page PDFDigital course
Beginner to advanced practiceLearn at your pace
English editionWritten guide
Updated 6 October 2026Edition date

What you’ll learn

  • Set up your business portfolio, ad account, payment settings and secure access.
  • Follow real WhatsApp campaign screens for the destination, budget, schedule, location and audience controls.
  • Test the complete customer journey, handle enquiries and review useful results.
  • Work through phone-call, website-traffic and Shopify-sales campaign scenarios.
  • Research public competitor ads in Meta Ad Library and turn observations into a creative test.
  • Choose a Pixel installation route, map real action events and verify the browser and Meta Test Events.
  • Understand Conversions API, browser/server event deduplication, consent and troubleshooting.
  • Complete the campaign worksheets and website-measurement sign-off checklist.

Inside the course

01   Get the foundations right

Account setup and secure access, pages 2–3. Campaign roadmap, page 4. Offer, goal and spending boundary, page 5. Connect WhatsApp, page 6.

02   Build a WhatsApp campaign from real screens

Ten-page screenshot-led walkthrough, pages 7–16: objective and manual setup; budget strategy; WhatsApp destination; test budget and schedule; audience controls, locations and suggestions; final draft review.

03   Create, launch, measure and improve

Creative and conversation starters, page 17. Test the whole journey, page 18. Handle enquiries, page 19. Measure results and choose the next change, pages 20–21.

04   Work through your own campaign

Launch checklist, page 22. Campaign brief, page 23. Enquiry tracker, page 24. First-test review, page 25.

05   Explore other business goals

Website tracking foundations, page 26. Phone calls, website traffic and Shopify sales, pages 27–30.

06   Read the interface and research public ads

Visual walkthrough and working levels, pages 31–33. Four competitor-research pages covering search, filters, analysis and a creative-test worksheet, pages 34–37.

07   Install the Pixel and map real events

Understand website measurement and select the source, pages 38–39. Partner/manual installation and Tag Manager, pages 40–42. Event mapping and success-triggered action events, pages 43–44.

08   Verify and troubleshoot measurement

Test Events, page 45. Conversions API and deduplication, pages 46–47. Consent and privacy, page 48. Troubleshooting and final sign-off, pages 49–50.

09   Use the references and teaching captures

Official references and publication notes, pages 51–54. Seventeen sanitised genuine interface captures, 34 external reference links, eight internal links and 54 PDF bookmarks support the lessons.

Made for you if…

For business owners and marketers who want campaign foundations, a practical public-ad research method and a structured approach to website measurement.

What’s included

  • The complete 54-page English PDF
  • Ten pages of screenshot-led WhatsApp campaign setup
  • Campaign lessons, scenarios, checklists and worksheets
  • Four pages of public competitor-ad research
  • Thirteen pages of Pixel setup, event testing and measurement guidance
  • 17 sanitised genuine interface captures
  • 42 clickable links (34 external references and eight internal links)
  • 54 PDF bookmarks

Before you begin

You will need an eligible Meta account and access to the business assets you use. Running ads requires a separate advertising budget. The WhatsApp example does not require a website; the Pixel lessons require an eligible website you are authorised to configure.

An independent Ascore educational course. Meta screens, policies and eligibility can change. Interface captures are sanitised teaching examples; Pixel implementation guidance is clearly labelled. Advertising performance and certification are not guaranteed.
